title: E-Commerce Platform
description: Full-stack e-commerce solution with payment integration
longDescription: A comprehensive e-commerce platform built with Angular and .NET Core. Features include product management, shopping cart, secure checkout with Stripe integration, order tracking, and admin dashboard.

title: Task Management App
description: Collaborative task management with real-time updates
longDescription: A real-time task management application with team collaboration features. Built with Angular and Firebase for instant synchronization across devices.

title: REST API Backend
description: Scalable REST API with authentication and authorization
longDescription: A robust REST API built with .NET Core featuring JWT authentication, role-based authorization, and comprehensive API documentation with Swagger.

title: Portfolio Website
description: Modern portfolio with dark mode and animations
longDescription: A fully responsive portfolio website with dark/light theme, smooth animations, and SEO optimization. Built with Angular and Tailwind CSS.
